correctness.rationale: Fix D,ell,kappa>0 finite and real drift mu. The renewal probability of absorption before exponential reset gives T=(ell^2/D)[(1+eta*w)e^{w+sigma*m}-1]/z^2 with eta=2D/(kappa*ell), m=|mu|ell/(2D), w=sqrt(m^2+z^2), z=ell sqrt(r/D). Set y=w-m, q=e^{-(sigma+1)m}; the derivative of F(y)/[y(y+2m)], F=(1+eta(m+y))e^y-q, has N(y)/y^2 strictly increasing from -infinity to +infinity (positive Taylor coefficients above order two and derivatives of negative reciprocals). At m=0 the analogous F/y^2 derivative also has one crossing. Coercivity proves the single positive nondegenerate global optimum. Exact identity tau_+=e^{2m}tau_-+(e^{2m}-1)/z^2 and unique derivative crossing imply r_away>r_toward. Uniform compactness and the nondegenerate limiting profile eta e^y/(2y) imply y_+=1-1/(2m)+O(m^-2), y_-=1-(1/2+1/(e eta))/m+O(m^-2), hence r_away=v/ell+O(v^-1), r_toward=v/ell-kappa/(e ell)+O(v^-1). Verified sign and O(1/m) offset numerically from independent bisection for m=1,10,100,2000, finite checks only. The singular kappa=infty regime excluded.
